name: Pix2Struct base (pretrained)
notes: Adjacent: a general visual-language pretraining checkpoint, not an agent or a UI-specific fine-tune. The card calls it the pretrained version of Pix2Struct for fine-tuning only, quotes the paper abstract, shows the T5X-to-Transformers conversion script, and says the weights were contributed by the Pix2Struct authors and added to Hugging Face by Younes Belkada. Hub API at revision 4605659e lists model.safetensors and pytorch_model.bin in the Pix2StructForConditionalGeneration architecture, with 282,285,696 F32 parameters reported for the safetensors file; the repository is not gated. The card gives no scores and does not link the Pix2Struct code repository, so no family relation is recorded. The card declares Apache-2.0 for the checkpoint; no pretraining data is part of this release.
summary: Pretrained base-size Pix2Struct checkpoint in Transformers format, learned by parsing masked web page screenshots into simplified HTML and released only as a starting point for fine-tuning.
